# BladeShadow

A shadcn/ui-inspired component library for Laravel Blade. Components are copied into your project (not rendered from a package) so you own and can edit them.

**Stack:** PHP 8.1+, Laravel 10–12, Blade, Tailwind CSS (v3 or v4), Alpine.js v3, blade-lucide icons.

---

## Setup

```bash
# 1. Add to composer.json repositories if using a local path:
# "repositories": [{"type": "path", "url": "/path/to/bladeshad"}]

composer require znibb/bladeshad

# 2. Run one-time setup (installs blade-lucide, publishes CSS + cn() helper)
php artisan bladeshad:init

# 3. Add to resources/css/app.css:
# @import './bladeshad.css';

# 4. Add components to your project
php artisan bladeshad:add button
php artisan bladeshad:add dialog       # auto-installs dependencies (button)
php artisan bladeshad:add --list       # see all available components
```

Components are copied to `resources/views/components/ui/` and used as `<x-ui.component-name />`.

Alpine.js must be loaded in your layout for interactive components (accordion, tabs, dialog, sheet, dropdown-menu, popover, tooltip, switch, checkbox, select, toggle).

---

## cn() helper

All components use a global `cn()` function that merges and deduplicates Tailwind classes:

```php
cn('px-4 py-2', 'px-4', null, 'font-bold') // → "px-4 py-2 font-bold"
```

---

## Components

### button

Props: `variant` (default|destructive|outline|secondary|ghost|link), `size` (default|sm|lg|icon)

```blade
<x-ui.button>Click me</x-ui.button>
<x-ui.button variant="destructive" size="sm">Delete</x-ui.button>
<x-ui.button variant="outline" class="mt-4">Cancel</x-ui.button>
<x-ui.button disabled>Disabled</x-ui.button>
```

---

### badge

Props: `variant` (default|secondary|destructive|outline)

```blade
<x-ui.badge>New</x-ui.badge>
<x-ui.badge variant="destructive">Error</x-ui.badge>
<x-ui.badge variant="outline">Beta</x-ui.badge>
```

---

### input

Props: `disabled` (bool, default false). Passes all attributes to `<input>`.

```blade
<x-ui.input type="text" placeholder="Search..." />
<x-ui.input type="email" name="email" wire:model="email" />
<x-ui.input disabled />
```

---

### label

Props: `disabled` (bool, default false)

```blade
<x-ui.label for="email">Email</x-ui.label>
<x-ui.label disabled>Disabled label</x-ui.label>
```

---

### textarea

Props: `disabled` (bool, default false), `rows` (int, default 3)

```blade
<x-ui.textarea name="bio" placeholder="Tell us about yourself" />
<x-ui.textarea rows="6" wire:model="content" />
```

---

### separator

Props: `orientation` (horizontal|vertical, default horizontal)

```blade
<x-ui.separator />
<x-ui.separator orientation="vertical" class="h-6" />
```

---

### skeleton

No props. Use `class` to set dimensions.

```blade
<x-ui.skeleton class="h-4 w-[250px]" />
<x-ui.skeleton class="h-12 w-12 rounded-full" />
```

---

### card

Sub-components: `card`, `card-header`, `card-title`, `card-description`, `card-content`, `card-footer`. No props.

```blade
<x-ui.card>
    <x-ui.card-header>
        <x-ui.card-title>Account</x-ui.card-title>
        <x-ui.card-description>Manage your account settings.</x-ui.card-description>
    </x-ui.card-header>
    <x-ui.card-content>
        Content here.
    </x-ui.card-content>
    <x-ui.card-footer>
        <x-ui.button>Save</x-ui.button>
    </x-ui.card-footer>
</x-ui.card>
```

---

### alert

Sub-components: `alert`, `alert-title`, `alert-description`.

Props on `alert`: `variant` (default|destructive)

```blade
<x-ui.alert>
    <x-ui.alert-title>Heads up!</x-ui.alert-title>
    <x-ui.alert-description>You can change this in settings.</x-ui.alert-description>
</x-ui.alert>

<x-ui.alert variant="destructive">
    <x-ui.alert-title>Error</x-ui.alert-title>
    <x-ui.alert-description>Something went wrong.</x-ui.alert-description>
</x-ui.alert>
```

---

### avatar

Sub-components: `avatar`, `avatar-image`, `avatar-fallback`. No props on wrapper.

Props on `avatar-image`: `src` (string), `alt` (string)

```blade
<x-ui.avatar>
    <x-ui.avatar-image src="/photo.jpg" alt="John Doe" />
    <x-ui.avatar-fallback>JD</x-ui.avatar-fallback>
</x-ui.avatar>
```

---

### table

Sub-components: `table`, `table-header`, `table-head`, `table-body`, `table-row`, `table-cell`, `table-footer`, `table-caption`. No props.

```blade
<x-ui.table>
    <x-ui.table-header>
        <x-ui.table-row>
            <x-ui.table-head>Name</x-ui.table-head>
            <x-ui.table-head>Email</x-ui.table-head>
        </x-ui.table-row>
    </x-ui.table-header>
    <x-ui.table-body>
        @foreach($users as $user)
        <x-ui.table-row>
            <x-ui.table-cell>{{ $user->name }}</x-ui.table-cell>
            <x-ui.table-cell>{{ $user->email }}</x-ui.table-cell>
        </x-ui.table-row>
        @endforeach
    </x-ui.table-body>
</x-ui.table>
```

---

### accordion

Sub-components: `accordion`, `accordion-item`, `accordion-trigger`, `accordion-content`.

Props on `accordion-item`: `value` (string, required — unique identifier).

Only one item open at a time. Uses Alpine.js `x-collapse` plugin.

```blade
<x-ui.accordion>
    <x-ui.accordion-item value="item-1">
        <x-ui.accordion-trigger>Is it accessible?</x-ui.accordion-trigger>
        <x-ui.accordion-content>Yes. It uses semantic HTML and ARIA attributes.</x-ui.accordion-content>
    </x-ui.accordion-item>
    <x-ui.accordion-item value="item-2">
        <x-ui.accordion-trigger>Is it styled?</x-ui.accordion-trigger>
        <x-ui.accordion-content>Yes. It comes with default Tailwind styles.</x-ui.accordion-content>
    </x-ui.accordion-item>
</x-ui.accordion>
```

---

### tabs

Sub-components: `tabs`, `tabs-list`, `tabs-trigger`, `tabs-content`.

Props on `tabs`: `default` (string — value of the initially active tab).
Props on `tabs-trigger` and `tabs-content`: `value` (string, required — must match between trigger and content).

```blade
<x-ui.tabs default="account">
    <x-ui.tabs-list>
        <x-ui.tabs-trigger value="account">Account</x-ui.tabs-trigger>
        <x-ui.tabs-trigger value="password">Password</x-ui.tabs-trigger>
    </x-ui.tabs-list>
    <x-ui.tabs-content value="account">Account settings here.</x-ui.tabs-content>
    <x-ui.tabs-content value="password">Change password here.</x-ui.tabs-content>
</x-ui.tabs>
```

---

### dialog

Sub-components: `dialog`, `dialog-trigger`, `dialog-overlay`, `dialog-content`, `dialog-header`, `dialog-title`, `dialog-description`, `dialog-footer`, `dialog-close`.

State (`open`) lives on `dialog`. Trigger, overlay, and content must be inside the `dialog` wrapper. Escape key and overlay click both close.

```blade
<x-ui.dialog>
    <x-ui.dialog-trigger>
        <x-ui.button>Open dialog</x-ui.button>
    </x-ui.dialog-trigger>
    <x-ui.dialog-overlay />
    <x-ui.dialog-content>
        <x-ui.dialog-header>
            <x-ui.dialog-title>Edit profile</x-ui.dialog-title>
            <x-ui.dialog-description>Make changes to your profile here.</x-ui.dialog-description>
        </x-ui.dialog-header>
        <x-ui.dialog-footer>
            <x-ui.dialog-close>
                <x-ui.button variant="outline">Cancel</x-ui.button>
            </x-ui.dialog-close>
            <x-ui.button>Save</x-ui.button>
        </x-ui.dialog-footer>
    </x-ui.dialog-content>
</x-ui.dialog>
```

---

### sheet

Sub-components: `sheet`, `sheet-trigger`, `sheet-overlay`, `sheet-content`, `sheet-header`, `sheet-title`, `sheet-description`, `sheet-footer`, `sheet-close`.

Same as dialog but slides in from a side.

Props on `sheet-content`: `side` (top|bottom|left|right, default right)

```blade
<x-ui.sheet>
    <x-ui.sheet-trigger>
        <x-ui.button variant="outline">Open sheet</x-ui.button>
    </x-ui.sheet-trigger>
    <x-ui.sheet-overlay />
    <x-ui.sheet-content side="right">
        <x-ui.sheet-header>
            <x-ui.sheet-title>Navigation</x-ui.sheet-title>
        </x-ui.sheet-header>
        Sheet content here.
    </x-ui.sheet-content>
</x-ui.sheet>
```

---

### alert-dialog

Sub-components: `alert-dialog`, `alert-dialog-content`, `alert-dialog-header`, `alert-dialog-title`, `alert-dialog-description`, `alert-dialog-footer`, `alert-dialog-action`, `alert-dialog-cancel`.

Like dialog but no X close button — user must explicitly choose action or cancel. Uses `role="alertdialog"`. Reuse `dialog-overlay` for the backdrop.

```blade
<x-ui.alert-dialog>
    <x-ui.dialog-trigger>
        <x-ui.button variant="destructive">Delete account</x-ui.button>
    </x-ui.dialog-trigger>
    <x-ui.dialog-overlay />
    <x-ui.alert-dialog-content>
        <x-ui.alert-dialog-header>
            <x-ui.alert-dialog-title>Are you absolutely sure?</x-ui.alert-dialog-title>
            <x-ui.alert-dialog-description>
                This action cannot be undone.
            </x-ui.alert-dialog-description>
        </x-ui.alert-dialog-header>
        <x-ui.alert-dialog-footer>
            <x-ui.alert-dialog-cancel>Cancel</x-ui.alert-dialog-cancel>
            <x-ui.alert-dialog-action>Continue</x-ui.alert-dialog-action>
        </x-ui.alert-dialog-footer>
    </x-ui.alert-dialog-content>
</x-ui.alert-dialog>
```

---

### dropdown-menu

Sub-components: `dropdown-menu`, `dropdown-menu-trigger`, `dropdown-menu-content`, `dropdown-menu-item`, `dropdown-menu-label`, `dropdown-menu-separator`, `dropdown-menu-shortcut`.

Clicking outside or clicking an item closes the menu.

```blade
<x-ui.dropdown-menu>
    <x-ui.dropdown-menu-trigger>
        <x-ui.button variant="outline">Options</x-ui.button>
    </x-ui.dropdown-menu-trigger>
    <x-ui.dropdown-menu-content>
        <x-ui.dropdown-menu-label>My Account</x-ui.dropdown-menu-label>
        <x-ui.dropdown-menu-separator />
        <x-ui.dropdown-menu-item>Profile</x-ui.dropdown-menu-item>
        <x-ui.dropdown-menu-item>
            Settings
            <x-ui.dropdown-menu-shortcut>⌘S</x-ui.dropdown-menu-shortcut>
        </x-ui.dropdown-menu-item>
        <x-ui.dropdown-menu-separator />
        <x-ui.dropdown-menu-item>Log out</x-ui.dropdown-menu-item>
    </x-ui.dropdown-menu-content>
</x-ui.dropdown-menu>
```

---

### popover

Sub-components: `popover`, `popover-trigger`, `popover-content`. Click trigger opens; click outside closes.

```blade
<x-ui.popover>
    <x-ui.popover-trigger>
        <x-ui.button variant="outline">Open popover</x-ui.button>
    </x-ui.popover-trigger>
    <x-ui.popover-content>
        <p class="text-sm">Popover content goes here.</p>
    </x-ui.popover-content>
</x-ui.popover>
```

---

### tooltip

Sub-components: `tooltip`, `tooltip-trigger`, `tooltip-content`. Shows on hover, positioned above trigger.

```blade
<x-ui.tooltip>
    <x-ui.tooltip-trigger>
        <x-ui.button variant="outline">Hover me</x-ui.button>
    </x-ui.tooltip-trigger>
    <x-ui.tooltip-content>This is a tooltip.</x-ui.tooltip-content>
</x-ui.tooltip>
```

---

### switch

Props: `checked` (bool, default false), `name` (string, for form submission), `value` (string, submitted when on, default "1"), `disabled` (bool).

Syncs with `wire:model` via `x-modelable`.

```blade
<x-ui.switch name="notifications" />
<x-ui.switch name="dark_mode" :checked="$user->dark_mode" />
<x-ui.switch wire:model="settings.notifications" />
```

---

### checkbox

Props: `disabled` (bool, default false). Passes `name`, `value`, `wire:model` etc. to the native `<input>`.

Slot renders a label next to the checkbox.

```blade
<x-ui.checkbox name="terms" />
<x-ui.checkbox name="subscribe" value="yes" wire:model="subscribe">
    Subscribe to newsletter
</x-ui.checkbox>
```

---

### select

Sub-components: `select`, `select-trigger`, `select-content`, `select-item`.

Props on `select`: `name` (string, for form submission), `placeholder` (string, default "Select..."), `disabled` (bool).
Props on `select-item`: `value` (string, required), `label` (string, required — shown in trigger when selected).

Syncs with `wire:model` via `x-modelable`.

```blade
<x-ui.select name="country" placeholder="Select country...">
    <x-ui.select-trigger />
    <x-ui.select-content>
        <x-ui.select-item value="se" label="Sweden" />
        <x-ui.select-item value="no" label="Norway" />
        <x-ui.select-item value="dk" label="Denmark" />
    </x-ui.select-content>
</x-ui.select>
```

---

### toggle

Props: `variant` (default|outline), `size` (default|sm|lg), `pressed` (bool, default false).

Syncs with `wire:model` via `x-modelable`.

```blade
<x-ui.toggle>Bold</x-ui.toggle>
<x-ui.toggle variant="outline" :pressed="$bold" wire:model="bold">
    <x-lucide-bold class="h-4 w-4" />
</x-ui.toggle>
```

---

### breadcrumb

Sub-components: `breadcrumb`, `breadcrumb-list`, `breadcrumb-item`, `breadcrumb-link`, `breadcrumb-page`, `breadcrumb-separator`, `breadcrumb-ellipsis`.

Props on `breadcrumb-link`: `href` (string, default "#").

Use `breadcrumb-page` (not `breadcrumb-link`) for the current page — it renders a non-clickable `<span>` with `aria-current="page"`.

```blade
<x-ui.breadcrumb>
    <x-ui.breadcrumb-list>
        <x-ui.breadcrumb-item>
            <x-ui.breadcrumb-link href="/">Home</x-ui.breadcrumb-link>
        </x-ui.breadcrumb-item>
        <x-ui.breadcrumb-separator />
        <x-ui.breadcrumb-item>
            <x-ui.breadcrumb-link href="/products">Products</x-ui.breadcrumb-link>
        </x-ui.breadcrumb-item>
        <x-ui.breadcrumb-separator />
        <x-ui.breadcrumb-item>
            <x-ui.breadcrumb-page>Laptop</x-ui.breadcrumb-page>
        </x-ui.breadcrumb-item>
    </x-ui.breadcrumb-list>
</x-ui.breadcrumb>
```

---

### pagination

Sub-components: `pagination`, `pagination-content`, `pagination-item`, `pagination-link`, `pagination-previous`, `pagination-next`, `pagination-ellipsis`.

Props on `pagination-link`: `href` (string), `isActive` (bool, default false — adds border and `aria-current="page"`).
Props on `pagination-previous` and `pagination-next`: `href` (string).

```blade
<x-ui.pagination>
    <x-ui.pagination-content>
        <x-ui.pagination-item>
            <x-ui.pagination-previous href="{{ $paginator->previousPageUrl() }}" />
        </x-ui.pagination-item>
        @for($i = 1; $i <= $paginator->lastPage(); $i++)
        <x-ui.pagination-item>
            <x-ui.pagination-link href="{{ $paginator->url($i) }}" :isActive="$paginator->currentPage() === $i">
                {{ $i }}
            </x-ui.pagination-link>
        </x-ui.pagination-item>
        @endfor
        <x-ui.pagination-item>
            <x-ui.pagination-next href="{{ $paginator->nextPageUrl() }}" />
        </x-ui.pagination-item>
    </x-ui.pagination-content>
</x-ui.pagination>
```

---

## Available components (for bladeshad:add)

button, badge, input, label, textarea, separator, skeleton, card, alert, avatar, table, accordion, tabs, dialog, sheet, alert-dialog, dropdown-menu, popover, tooltip, switch, checkbox, select, toggle, breadcrumb, pagination
